senses.gloss: גִּלֵּחַ, גִּילֵּחַ to cut the hair, shave.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Nazir 4:6">Ib. IV, 6</cite> <he>ג׳ או גִילְּחוּהוּ וכ׳</he> if he himself or his friends cut his hair.
<cite ref="Mishnah Moed Katan 3:1">M. Kat. III, 1</cite> <he>ואלו מְגַלְּחִין וכ׳</he> the following are permitted to cut their hair during the festive week.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 14a:16">Ib. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>מותר לְגַלֵּחַ</he>; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְגוּלָּח</he>, f. <he>מְגוּלַּחַת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Nazir 4:5">Naz. IV, 5</cite> <he>אשה מְגֻלַּ׳</he> a woman with her hair cut; Y. ib. IV, end, 53ᶜ
